item.title: Typhoon Champi kills 1 and injures 350 in Taiwan overnight as storm weakens
item.description: Typhoon Champi has killed one person and injured hundreds in Taiwan. The storm's strong winds and rains continued Friday night into Saturday morning, downing trees and knocking out power for hundreds of thousands of people.

item.title: US is reducing staffing at 4 Middle East embassies over increased threats from Iran
item.description: The State Department says it will reduce staffing at four U.S. embassies in the Middle East after receiving intelligence that Iran has stepped up efforts to target American personnel in the region and elsewhere.

item.title: DOJ orders some California counties to verify ballots in 48 hours
item.description: Federal prosecutors are demanding that county registrars across California set aside and verify ballots that may belong to noncitizens.

item.title: Brewers' Jacob Misiorowski sets World Series velocity record on his first pitch
item.description: Jacob Misiorowski broke the record for fastest World Series pitch with the very first offering of this year’s Fall Classic, a 103.5 mph fastball from the Milwaukee Brewers’ fireballer to the Tampa Bay Rays’ Yandy Díaz on Friday night.

item.title: Union head calls MLB's salary cap proposal 'nuclear bomb' ahead of World Series opener
item.description: Baseball’s union chief said the owners’ proposal of a salary cap this summer was a “nuclear bomb” and players have no interest in the type of economic system Commissioner Rob Manfred maintains is needed for the sport to thrive.
